effectSummary.ko: 삼원소 붕괴를 선택하면 세 번째 단계의 첫 적중 시 원소별 충전을 쓰지 않고 자원 15을 한 번 회복합니다. 현자의 화신을 선택하면 세 원소 순환의 추가 폭발 반경이 2.5m에서 3m로 늘어납니다. 다른 궁극기를 시전하지 않습니다.
effectSummary.en: With Triune Collapse selected, its third stage's first hit restores 15 resource once without consuming elemental charges. With Sage Incarnate selected, three-element completion bursts grow from 2.5m to 3m. Never cast the other ultimate.

description.ko: 10m 안의 반경 4m에 화염 D200%, 0.5초 뒤 냉기 D150%, 다시 0.5초 뒤 번개 D150%를 가합니다. 각 단계 최대 8명이며 냉기는 1초 빙결을 줍니다. M01·M02·M03을 대신 시전한 것으로 세지 않습니다.
description.en: Strike a 4m area within 10m for D200% fire, then D150% cold after 0.5s, then D150% lightning after another 0.5s. Each stage hits up to 8 enemies; cold freezes for 1s. These stages do not count as M01, M02 or M03 casts.

description.ko: 8초간 최대 HP 25% 보호막을 얻고 일반 액티브 피해 +20%, 비용 감소 +20%p를 얻습니다. 이 시간에 서로 다른 세 원소의 일반 액티브를 시전하면 마지막 기술의 첫 적중 위치에 반경 2.5m·최대 5명에게 원소별 D40% 추가 폭발이 일어납니다. 순환 완성당 1회, 시전 전체 최대 2회입니다.
description.en: Gain a 25% maximum-HP barrier for 8s, +20% normal-active damage and +20 percentage points of normal-active cost reduction. Completing a three-element normal-active cast cycle triggers D40% per element within 2.5m, up to 5 targets, at the last skill's first impact. Once per completed cycle, at most twice per ultimate.

concept: One finger ring with a three-point crownstone bezel, three broad mineral facets of ember red, glacial blue and storm violet sharing one dark silver setting. Heavy triangular crown profile and open bronze band; no separate elements or spell effects.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon. Metadata only, never write it in the image: DES_LM46, Threefold Crownstone, class Mage, slot finger ring.
Subject design: One finger ring with a three-point crownstone bezel, three broad mineral facets of ember red, glacial blue and storm violet sharing one dark silver setting. Heavy triangular crown profile and open bronze band; no separate elements or spell effects.
Power that informs materials and structure, not a spell illustration: With Triune Collapse selected, its third stage's first hit restores 15 resource once without consuming elemental charges. With Sage Incarnate selected, three-element completion bursts grow from 2.5m to 3m. Never cast the other ultimate.
Direct skill context: M17 Triune Collapse — Strike a 4m area within 10m for D200% fire, then D150% cold after 0.5s, then D150% lightning after another 0.5s. Each stage hits up to 8 enemies; cold freezes for 1s. These stages do not count as M01, M02 or M03 casts.; M18 Sage Incarnate — Gain a 25% maximum-HP barrier for 8s, +20% normal-active damage and +20 percentage points of normal-active cost reduction. Completing a three-element normal-active cast cycle triggers D40% per element within 2.5m, up to 5 targets, at the last skill's first impact. Once per completed cycle, at most twice per ultimate.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy equipment, worn and chipped metal, rough leather or aged cloth, strong directional upper-left highlights, deep but readable shadows. Earthy charcoal, silver, restrained old bronze; individual restrained effect colors only within the physical object. Large shapes, few decisive details, silhouette and material structure distinguish the item. Never a flat vector symbol.
Composition and file: 1024 by 1024 pixel square PNG requested, with genuinely native transparent alpha. ONE tangible item, or ONE tightly overlapping pair for hands or feet, with no wearer. Scale the equipment down within the square: the full object should occupy only the CENTRAL 72% of canvas width and height. Keep at least 14% completely empty transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides, including above crown peaks and around both weapon tips. Do not zoom in or maximize its size. Complete object, no clipping, no missing tips. This visible empty margin is essential. Make the item strong and clear at 64px. Weapons diagonal; jewelry at three-quarter angle; other armor mostly frontal three-quarter view.
Transparency is mandatory: genuinely transparent surrounding area and internal empty holes with preserved native alpha, clean antialiased edges, no matte, no colored fringe. The image file must contain a real alpha channel; never paint a checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, readable runes, labels, watermark, UI frame, border, panel, badge, background, scenery, solid backdrop, gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow cloud, fog, detached particles, floating spell effects, duplicate items, collage, human body or hands. Equipment shape dominates; do not cover it with enormous effects. Do not copy any existing game icon.
